Finalized subcomponent design Many of the design challenges consisted of deflection resulting in concentrated stress along corners of the original design. As a result, fillets were applied to the interior features and an additional flange was added to the top of the subcomponent for ease of attaching to the full frame that was analyzed with the component. Other considerations included weight, such that the target weight was approximately 30% less than that of the Ford original component. The original ford subcomponent had a mass of 1.68kg with the new subcomponent at 1.22kg there is a 27% reduction in mass. With the final design iteration, the comparison is much more effective than the initial design.
